about_the_game:
👁️ Spectator has returned!

Welcome to Spectator 3—the next chapter in the anomaly-spotting psychological horror series. It's a brand-new descent into paranoia. Spectator 3 amplifies everything — the fear, the mystery, the horror.

🌀 What You See Can Hurt You

You are the Spectator. Behind a wall of flickering screens, you must detect the undetectable — things that shouldn’t be. A painting changed. A figure moved. A whisper that leaves no echo.

Miss one… and it spreads.

🕵️‍♀️ New Features Include:

  • A NEW LEVEL OF DREAD
    Security feeds from even more twisted environments. The anomalies are smarter, bolder — and now, some of them know you're watching. Your perception is your last line of defense. Use it wisely.

  • DYNAMIC ANOMALY SYSTEM
    No two playthroughs are alike. Every session is procedurally haunted with layers of randomized, reactive phenomena.

  • DEEPER HORROR, DARKER LORE

    An expanded narrative weaves throughout every camera feed. Cryptic messages, recurring figures, and overlapping timelines hint at a hidden truth. Can you piece it together before everything breaks?

  • CO-OP, EVOLVED
    Play alone or with a friend in upgraded split-screen and online multiplayer. Share the fear, coordinate your reports… or turn on each other when reality bends a little too far.

Spectator 3 isn't just about spotting what's wrong.
It's about questioning what’s right.

🎮 What's in the Prologue?

The Spectator 3 Prologue offers a focused look at the game's core mechanics and atmosphere. In this demo, you will:

  • Play through one full level designed to showcase the game's horror, suspense, and anomaly-spotting gameplay.

  • Experience the full anomaly reporting system with randomized events that ensure every playthrough is different.

  • Uncover cryptic details and early pieces of the game's overarching story and atmosphere.

Note: This demo is single-player only. Co-op and multiplayer features are only available in the full version.
